definitions.explanation: Vibrations that travel through air or other media and can be heard. Includes all kinds of sounds, from music to everyday noises.

examples.english: There was a loud sound outside, but I couldn't tell what it was.
When I hear small sounds at night when it's quiet, it's a bit scary. It's because I don't know what the sound is.

notes:
{音|おと} refers to sounds in general, especially non-vocal sounds. Different from ⟦{声|こえ}→こえ：02207⟧ (voice), which specifically refers to sounds made by humans or animals.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {音|おと}がする (a sound is heard/made)
- {音|おと}を⟦{立|た}てる→たてる：01196⟧ (to make a sound)
- {音|おと}が⟦{聞|き}こえる→きこえる：01229⟧ (to be able to hear a sound)
- {音|おと}を{小|ちい}さくする (to turn down the volume)

COMPOUND WORDS:
- ⟦{足音|あしおと}→あしおと：02991⟧ (footsteps)
- ⟦{物音|ものおと}→ものおと：03633⟧ (sound of something)
- ⟦{音楽|おんがく}→おんがく：00661⟧ (music)
- ⟦{音声|おんせい}→おんせい：04445⟧ (audio, voice)
- ⟦{騒音|そうおん}→そうおん：03315⟧ (noise, din)
- ⟦{雑音|ざつおん}→ざつおん：04191⟧ (static, noise)

READINGS:
Usually おと, but often おん in compounds: ⟦{音量|おんりょう}→おんりょう：10009⟧ (volume), ⟦{発音|はつおん}→はつおん：01698⟧ (pronunciation).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{声|こえ}→こえ：02207⟧: voice (human/animal sounds)
- ⟦{響|ひび}き→ひびき：00098⟧: resonance, echo
